issues: Static validation 'ui primary flow' fails at step 46 (click button "Export" on the Settings screen) at both phone and desktop sizes, with page error 'Maximum call stack size exceeded'. Confirmed root cause: `src/screens/RestoreScreen.web.tsx` contains `export { default } from './RestoreScreen';`. On web, Metro/Jest resolve `./RestoreScreen` from inside the `.web.tsx` file back to `RestoreScreen.web.tsx` itself, so the module re-exports its own default forever. I reproduced it directly: importing `src/screens/RestoreScreen` under the web preset throws with an endless stack of `at Object.get [as default] (src/screens/RestoreScreen.web.tsx:8:27)` frames. Fix: delete `src/screens/RestoreScreen.web.tsx` (and the empty `src/screens/RestoreScreen.native.tsx`) so the single `RestoreScreen.tsx` is used, or rename the shared implementation to a distinct filename (e.g. `RestoreScreenShared.tsx`) and have the platform files re-export that.

Related to the same defect: `src/navigation/index.tsx` line 36 registers `component={RestoreScreen}` for the 'Restore' screen; because the default export resolves to an infinitely-recursive getter, React Navigation throws "Got an invalid value for 'component' prop for the screen 'Restore'. It must be a valid React Component." I reproduced this by rendering `<Navigation />` in a test — the whole Settings stack (and therefore the Export button in the flow) never mounts. Verify after the fix that the full M3/M4 flow (Settings → Export → Export CSV/PDF, Settings → Backup & restore → Restore) renders.

unconfirmed: the ui_flow expects a 'Restore from backup' button on the backup_success screen and a 'Delete all data' confirmation dialog with a 'Delete' button; `src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx` uses React Native's `Alert.alert`, which renders nothing on web, so step 'Delete all data' → 'Delete' will likely also fail once the flow proceeds past step 46. Please re-run the primary flow end to end after fixing the Restore module and replace `Alert.alert` with a Paper `Portal`/`Dialog` (per DESIGN.md's DeleteAllDataConfirmation) that shows 'All data deleted.' on success.
feedback: The acceptance tests pass, but blocking static validation ('ui primary flow') fails and the cause is a real bug, not a test artefact: `src/screens/RestoreScreen.web.tsx` re-exports its own default (`export { default } from './RestoreScreen'` resolves back to the .web file on web), producing infinite recursion ('Maximum call stack size exceeded') and making the Settings stack fail to mount with "Got an invalid value for 'component' prop for the screen 'Restore'". Remove the self-referential platform files (or rename the shared implementation), then re-run the full UI flow; also check the Delete-all-data confirmation, which currently relies on `Alert.alert` and has no web rendering.
